accroche.texte: ECC installs a working method into your coding agent, instead of restating it in every prompt
passages: Instead of rebuilding that process in every prompt, you install it once and make it part of how your agent works.

description.texte: Plan before coding, verify through tests, keep what matters: ECC brings together 71 agents, 314 skills, hooks and session summaries so this process becomes part of how your agent works. Today it works best with Claude Code, with native plugins for Codex and Qoder and more limited adapters for Cursor, OpenCode or Gemini.
passages: Access to 71 agents, 314 skills, and 98 legacy command shims, plus hooks, rules, memory, continuous learning, and AgentShield security scanning.
it plans before it builds, verifies changes with tests, reviews its own work from a fresh context, remembers what matters
Sessions are distilled into summaries, instincts, and reusable skills
make it part of how your agent works

It works best with Claude Code today, has native Codex and Qoder plugin paths, and provides capability-limited adapters for Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini, Zed, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity, Qwen, and other harnesses.

interet.texte: The plan becomes a document to approve before the first line, TDD requires a failing test before implementation, and hooks add checks that no longer depend on the prompt. These hooks run shell commands on your machine: install ECC only from the official repository or the npm package ecc-universal, since unofficial copies may contain malware.
passages: Plans become editable artifacts before implementation starts
TDD becomes a gated RED -> GREEN -> REFACTOR workflow with evidence
capture RED evidence before implementation
Hooks can enforce deterministic checks outside the prompt
Hooks can run shell commands
Install ECC only from verified channels: the GitHub repository github.com/affaan-m/ECC, the npm packages ecc-universal and ecc-agentshield
Third-party re-uploads and unofficial mirrors are not maintained or reviewed by the project and may contain malware.

exemple_usage.texte: For a new feature, depending on the repository: /ecc:plan with the request, plan approval, then tdd-workflow has a failing test written before implementing. Then comes a review in a fresh context and a check of the build, lint, types and tests.
passages: /ecc:plan "Add usage-based billing alerts" -> confirm or edit the plan -> activate tdd-workflow -> capture RED evidence before implementation
implement until GREEN -> review from fresh context -> fix findings with regression tests -> verify build, lint, types, and tests

termes_proches.raison: ECC se présente comme un système d'optimisation des performances du harness de l'agent.
ECC propose un cycle TDD, avec un test en échec avant le code.
ECC fournit des agents spécialisés pour la planification, la relecture et la sécurité.
ECC fournit des hooks, à activer ou non, qui ajoutent des contrôles hors du prompt.
ECC s'installe comme plugin Claude Code, par l'installation guidée ou par /plugin.
ECC peut tirer des sessions passées des instincts et des skills réutilisables.
AgentShield, l'outil d'audit associé à ECC et installé à part, analyse la configuration de l'agent.
ECC structure le travail d'un agent de code comme Claude Code ou Codex.
